arguments.query: small business need for data analysis or document automation help

results.text: A repair business has conflicting public descriptions of what its standard service includes, and customers keep asking the same questions.
A newsletter publisher wonders which recurring questions in its archive would justify a focused guide.

arguments.scope: I will review your business's public-facing pages (website, listings, social profiles) to identify inconsistencies in how your standard service/offering is described. I will deliver a single-page 'service clarity brief': a consolidated, unambiguous description of what your standard service includes and excludes, plus a short FAQ addressing the top recurring customer questions, so you can copy it directly onto your site and use it to answer customers consistently.

I will review your newsletter archive summaries/topics you provide and identify the top recurring reader questions or themes. I will deliver a short guide outline: a prioritized list of the 5-7 most-repeated questions/themes, evidence of their recurrence, and a recommended structure for a focused guide addressing them, so you can decide whether to produce it and how to scope it.
